name: Neuromuscular Scoliosis
definition: Spinal deformity developing secondary to neuromuscular conditions such as cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy or spinal muscular atrophy.

investigations.principle: Standing or sitting full-spine radiographs quantify curve and pelvic obliquity.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Surgery is individualized according to progression, function, respiratory status and underlying disease.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vakra-prishtha and neuromuscular Vata phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Spinal deformity developing secondary to neuromuscular conditions such as cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy or spinal muscular atrophy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
